name: The State of the Mines
summary: Toxic metals are turning up in Westfall's wells, and Alba Fairmoon fears for the farmland. She suspects the Defias mines and warns that the soil could fail for decades. You head to Jangolode Mine and Gold Coast Quarry to disrupt the mining.

sections.title: Poisoning the Land
sections.body: Alba Fairmoon finds dangerous levels of toxic metals in Westfall's wells. Once Stormwind's main breadbasket, the region now faces a threat to its crops. Alba suspects the Defias Brotherhood is poisoning the water through the mines it seized. If the contamination continues, the surrounding earth could lie barren for decades.

sections.title: Forced and Enlisted Labor
sections.body: The Defias put local creatures to work alongside their highwaymen, stripping Westfall of its resources. Riverpaw gnolls dig for stone and minerals at Gold Coast Quarry, while kobold diggers tunnel through Jangolode Mine. Disrupting their labor weakens the Defias' ability to process and distribute contaminated minerals.

faq.q: Why are the mines of Westfall leaking toxic metals?
faq.answer: Alba Fairmoon suspects the mines seized by the Defias Brotherhood are contaminating Westfall's groundwater with toxic metals. She wants to disrupt their miners to stop the pollution.

faq.q: Who is behind the mining operations in Westfall?
faq.answer: The Defias Brotherhood controls Westfall's mining operations. They seized former kingdom infrastructure and set Riverpaw gnolls and kobolds to extract minerals.

faq.q: Where are the Riverpaw gnolls and kobolds working?
faq.answer: Riverpaw gnolls work at Gold Coast Quarry along Westfall's western shores, while kobold diggers work inside Jangolode Mine to the north.

aliases: who gives state of the mines
faq.answer: Alba Fairmoon investigates Westfall's water and seeks to protect the region's farmland from lasting damage.

faq.q: Why are gnolls and kobolds working for the Defias?
faq.answer: The Defias use gnolls and kobolds as labor in the seized mines. Alba does not say how the workers were recruited.

faq.q: Can the land in Westfall recover from this contamination?
faq.answer: Alba Fairmoon says the soil can recover if the source of the toxicity is cut off quickly. If mining continues, the earth could remain infertile and blighted for decades.

angles.text: At Jangolode Mine and Gold Coast Quarry, the Defias extract minerals with little regard for safety or the mines' structural integrity.
As a druid, you face an urgent threat from metallic poisons seeping into Westfall's plains and coastal ecosystems.
As an Alliance member, you know Westfall helps feed Stormwind. If the Defias ruin its farmland, the kingdom could face famine for years.
